text: 中国证监会副主席李超9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上说，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放，力争到2030年资本市场建立四十周年之际，基本形成资本市场高质量发展新格局，综合实力与国际竞争力明显提高。（新华社）
text_en: China Securities Regulatory Commission Vice Chairman Li Chao said on September 10 at the State Council Information Office's "Starting Off and Setting Out for the '15th Five-Year Plan'" series of themed press conferences that the CSRC will accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up, and strive to basically form a new pattern of high-quality capital market development by 2030, the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the capital market, with comprehensive strength and international competitiveness significantly improved. (Xinhua News Agency)
